import_provenance.original_title: Polynomial-time constant approximation for the General Scheduling Problem
import_provenance.original_statement: For preemptive scheduling on one machine, with release times and arbitrary nonnegative nondecreasing job-specific completion-cost functions, is there a polynomial-time constant-factor approximation to the sum of costs? This asks to improve the O(log log P) guarantee of Bansal and Pruhs, where P is the ratio of largest to smallest processing time.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The November 2025 constant-factor result is quasipolynomial-time and assumes quasipolynomially bounded integer processing times; it does not resolve the polynomial-time question.
